evidence: Focused tests reject a different valid SQLite file before backup, registry, or schema changes through migration CLI commands.
Environment override does not redefine the protected target; recovery rejects protected production before opening a write-capable connection.
Relative, case-variant, symlink, direct protected, and Windows directory-junction aliases were rejected in isolated checks.
Exported migration_lifecycle.backup_database() is not guarded and created a backup for a different valid temporary database when called directly.
Nonexistent target behavior was inspected in source; it was not separately executed.
Reference schema is generated by running Migration 001 in memory; table definitions, columns, foreign keys, and explicit/automatic index layouts are compared.

_canonical_sql case-folds quoted literals: changing CHECK value 'deleted' to 'DELETED' was reported as APPLIED with no problems; lowercase inserts then failed; the drifted schema was recorded as BASELINED with applied_at null.
An unexpected trigger that aborts inserts was ignored and its schema was recorded as BASELINED.
Existing negative fixtures for missing index, foreign key, unique constraint, check constraint, altered table/index, and missing trigger passed.
Normal extraction recognizes DZD, EUR, and USD; unsupported source values are preserved as raw evidence and left untrusted.
Review helper downgrades unsupported codes, but append_facebook_price_evidence accepts caller-constructed candidates without currency validation.
Isolated public-repository reproduction returned a trusted_price_evidence row with currency XYZ and basis INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED.
The view enforces approved review, quality, unit, identity, amount, and price-type conditions, but does not whitelist currency codes.
Migration 001 writes DZD for every historical listing observation; in current production all 17 such rows have NULL prices because their legacy current_price values are zero.
Foundation rollback refuses without backup or DDL; byte-for-byte and unexpected-object test passed.
Restore stages and verifies a copy, preserves the prior database, and preserves existing WAL/SHM sidecars beside it.
Stopping writers is documented but cannot be reliably verified by the code.
Backup verification checks integrity and foreign keys but does not bind the backup to the target database or required migration/version.

tests.command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.test_foundation_v2 tests.test_migration_lifecycle tests.test_migration_cli_safety tests.test_price_evidence tests.test_ouedkniss_sensor_v2 -q
tests.isolation_review: Focused tests use temporary databases. CLI alias tests only inspect or refuse the protected path.
Full-suite benchmark opens production read-only, backs it up to a temporary benchmark file, and performs benchmark writes only on that copy.

isolated_reproductions.result: Trusted view returned currency XYZ with basis INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED using a caller-constructed Facebook extraction and approved review.
Validator returned no problems; inspect state was APPLIED; changed CHECK rejected lowercase deleted; baseline row was BASELINED with applied_at null.
Validator returned no problems and baseline row was BASELINED despite an unexpected aborting trigger.
Direct backup_database call created a backup for a valid temporary database without a target-policy rejection.
Temporary directory junction resolved to protected database; samefile was true and isolated mode refused it.
